standard_prerequisites.name: n!-identity for divided powers
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies x^{pN} = (pN)! gamma_{pN}(x) used in the forward direction.

core_obligations: Forward: if p^N = 0 in A, write x^{pN} = (pN)! gamma_{pN}(x) and note (pN)! is divisible by p^N, hence zero.
Converse: p nilpotent in A/I gives p^r in I for some r; local nilpotence of I makes p^r nilpotent, hence p nilpotent.
proof_roadmap: Two short directions: the factorial divisibility computation and the p^r in I transfer.
difficulty_reason: Two-line argument on each side; the only content is the n!-identity application.
